name: fullpos-ad-studio
description: MVP for generating professional software ad videos for FullPOS Cloud.

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace @fullpos-ad-studio/api & npm run dev --workspace @fullpos-ad-studio/web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @fullpos-ad-studio/shared && npm run build --workspace @fullpos-ad-studio/video && npm run build --workspace @fullpos-ad-studio/api && npm run build --workspace @fullpos-ad-studio/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @fullpos-ad-studio/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @fullpos-ad-studio/video && npm run typecheck --workspace @fullpos-ad-studio/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @fullpos-ad-studio/web
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @fullpos-ad-studio/shared && npm run build --workspace @fullpos-ad-studio/video && npm run build --workspace @fullpos-ad-studio/api && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
